doc.title: Catherine Russell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 26, 2018

title: Five dollars a performance, her first gig
summary: The Aida dancers were paid five dollars a performance.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Yeah. They paid us five dollars a performance.
That was one dollar more than I made on my first gig. And it wasn’t at Lincoln Center.
You know it sounds funny. Five dollars actually bought something in those days.
